# Docto — patient datafeed import (for LLM / integrator agents)

Purpose: generate a JSON file a user can import into an unlocked Docto vault
to create or update patient health records (doctors, appointments, visits,
medications, doses, readings, file metadata).

## WARNING

Feeds contain PLAINTEXT HEALTH / PII. Treat as highly sensitive. Binary uploads
(photos, PDFs) are NOT included in v1 — only structured records.

## Format

Envelope (required):
- version: 1
- type: "patient" | "doctors" | "appointments" | "visits" | "medications"
  | "readings" | "files"  (legacy alias: "docto-backup" == "patient")

Full patient feed (preferred for agents):
- type: "patient"
- patient (profile object)
- doctors[], appointments[], visits[], medications[], doses[], readings[], files[]

Typed feeds use items[] for a single collection.

Optional: exportedAt (ISO-8601)

## Machine-readable contract

- JSON Schema: https://project-docto.web.app/agent/import.schema.json
- Sample JSON: https://project-docto.web.app/agent/sample.json
- Human spec (repo): datafeed/README.md

## How users import

1. Sign in at https://project-docto.web.app
2. Unlock the vault (owner or Can help)
3. Settings → Import / Export → Choose JSON file

## Cross-references

Optional string id on doctors, offices, appointments, visits, medications is
used ONLY within the file (doctorId, officeId, medicationId, …). Docto always
creates new DB rows and remaps ids. Any unique string works (e.g. "doc-1").

Unknown fields are ignored. Active patient is the import target; optional
patient profile fields update the current patient.
